workload: ideal circuits; in-process simulators get the identical U/CX list, QPUTwin the source QASM (compiled to Helios natives). run_s = simulate + sample 1024 shots, or the client-measured HTTP round trip for the QPUTwin stack; engine_s = QPUTwin simulation + sampling from its telemetry. With 4 threads QPUTwin is the running stack (engine threads = worker CPU quota = 4); with 1 thread it is the same code in-process. Best of 3 repetitions below 2 s; a series stops after the first width above 60 s
